purpose: Dispatch already-declared exterior recomputation gates without altering candidate branches or promoting source, proof, model, execution, pilot, production, or authority standing.

held_lanes.reason: PR #84 correction and exterior review precede PR #86 dependency review.
Separate execution authorization and empirical protocol are required.
No production, pilot, or proof-standing inheritance from the proof queue.

reviewer_independence_rule: The exterior result must disclose reviewer identity or pseudonymous handle, relationship to Fork/construction, and whether the reviewer participated in candidate construction. Construction-assisted or same-loop review must not be labeled independent.
return_rule: Preserve exact head, environment, commands, raw outputs or machine-readable receipts, exit codes where available, artifact digests, corrections, unresolved matters, and one bounded disposition. A conforming return changes no standing until separately preserved and adjudicated.
